1278-3327-4508-5147.easyPrerequisites: Lightning-Rig Crew doesn't have summoning sickness.
1278-3327-4508-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1278-3327-4508-5147.description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} due to its cost reduction, including its commander tax.
Lightning-Rig Crew triggers, untapping it.
Resolve Dargo. Then, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

789-2399-3899--129.easyPrerequisites: Gutter Grime has slime counters on it at least equal to the toughness of the creature card in your hand.
789-2399-3899--129.description:
Cast the creature card in your hand by paying {0}.
Either that creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, or activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing that creature.
Gutter Grime triggers, putting a slime counter on it and creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Ooze.
When the Ooze dies, Colfenor triggers, returning the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
If the Spawning Pit ability is not a mana ability, resolve those abilities now.
Repeat.
789-2399-3899--129.notes: This combo also puts infinite slime counters on Gutter Grime, allowing you to easily create additional infinitely large creature tokens.

628-5405-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Soulstinger.
When Soulstinger dies, its undying ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, optionally putting -1/-1 counter(s) on another creature.
Resolve the Soulstinger trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Soulstinger enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

1981-2415-3967-5468.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3967-5468.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2034-2728-6854-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2034-2728-6854-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2034-2728-6854-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

1368-4927-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4927-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1170-5195-7495.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell from exile by paying one mana, unpreparing Skycoach Conductor // All Aboard.
When you cast this, Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist triggers.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten ability, flickering Skycoach Conductor // All Aboard, which enters prepared.
Resolve the remaining trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Repeat.

2067-6466.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
When the Pegasi enter, Shocking Sharpshooter triggers that many times, dealing that much damage divided among your opponents.

4976-6797-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
4976-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Open the Graves and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

985-2113-3713-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

2366-4178-4785-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a Forest that does not have summoning sickness and that enters the battlefield untapped.
2366-4178-4785-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.

2292-6761-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Scouring Swarm trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Scouring Swarm trigger, untapping it and creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
2292-6761-7084.notes: If you have seven or more land cards in your graveyard, this combo can create infinite creature tokens if you start it with two or more Scouring Swarms.

1978-5089-6893.description:
Animate The Eternity Elevator using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat from step 2.
1978-5089-6893.notes: If The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it, you can instead use its second ability to get infinite colored mana. You can also use both interchangeably, if desired.

2173-3661-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

67-1676-5670-5789-6917.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-1676-5670-5789-6917.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Lifecreed Duo and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Citizens enter, Lifecreed Duo triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
67-1676-5670-5789-6917.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.

225-539-872-3257.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaled Herbalist as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

997-1231-4826-6644.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3705-4924-5231-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1525-1594-5751-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

2425-5686-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2425-5686-6249--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Smothering Abomination trigger.
Resolve the Smothering Abomination trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

4231-4321-5777-5903.description:
Activate a Food by paying {2}, tapping and sacrificing it.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token, a Food token, a Clue token and a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2, as the Treasure is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.

457-1251-5159-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-1251-5159-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

4763-4955-5173-6068.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Shambling Ghast.
Activate Dissection Tools by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, targeting Koll.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to Koll.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1283-1496-4078-4242-5256.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1283-1496-4078-4242-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Su-Chi's power.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

1496-4186-4384.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-4186-4384.description:
Gain life.
Treebeard's second ability triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1608-2043-4659.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Triplicate Titan that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Triplicate Titan, adding {C}{C}.
When Triplicate Titan dies, it triggers, creating three 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Golems, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Urza to make infinite copies of any artifacts you control.

391-1636-1776.notablePrerequisites: Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
391-1636-1776.description:
Activate the land with Spawning Grounds attached by tapping it, creating a 5/5 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping the land with Spawning Grounds attached.
Repeat.

2679-3096.notablePrerequisites: There are no white cards in library.
2679-3096.description:
Activate Sacred Guide for {1}{W}, exiling your library.
Draw a card, winning the game.
Activate Jace's +1, winning the game.

1636-1763-2273-4587.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional Sliver.
An additional Sliver with mana value 1 in library.
1636-1763-2273-4587.description:
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Sliver Overlord's first ability by paying {3}, searching your library for a Sliver with mana value 1.
Cast that Sliver by paying {1}.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat, gaining {1} more each time in step 1 and searching for a Sliver costing up to {1} more each time in step 2.

1267-3423-4464-4600-5241.notablePrerequisites: Slither Blade does not have summoning sickness.
1267-3423-4464-4600-5241.description:
Declare Slither Blade as an attacker.
During the declare blockers phase, when you recieve priority, activate Sakashima's Student's Ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Slither Blade from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sakashima's Student from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai.
Deal combat damage with Sakashima's Student, causing you to take an additional turn after this one.
Cast Slither Blade by paying {U}.
Activate Aegis Automaton by paying {4}{W}, returning Sakashima's Student from the battlefield to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
